text:
alyssa_sales: Hey @miguel_se — FinTechCo asked if we can waive the VPC/private platform fee for a 6-week pilot. They want minimal friction for exec signoff and also sent a security questionnaire. CC @ben_dealdesk

miguel_se: Are they asking VPC in their AWS or full on-prem air-gapped? Platform fee covers the private control plane, install support, and a little ops runway. For short pilots we sometimes offer a credit/waiver.

alyssa_sales: VPC in their AWS account (not air-gapped). Pilot: non-PII data, ~200k tokens/day, small team of 3. They love the runtime performance but need to avoid a $20k up-front line item for the pilot.

ben_dealdesk: What's the expected ARR if they convert? We need ACV to justify fee concessions.

alyssa_sales: Sales estimate ~ $180k ARR year 1, potential expansion in 18 months. Customer pushing for zero platform fee for the pilot.

sarah_revenueops: FYI rate-card quick reference: `PLATFORM_PRIVATE = $20,000/yr`, `SUPPORT_STD = $10,000/yr (8x5)`, `SUPPORT_PREM = $25,000/yr (24x7)`. We can offer a 3-month complimentary platform credit for POCs if there is an MOU + committed MRV >= $150k within 90 days.

ben_dealdesk: If they want a full waiver we need stronger commitment. Proposal: provisional approval to waive platform fee for up to 8 weeks if all met: (1) signed MOU with conversion window, (2) documented acceptance criteria, (3) min commit $150k ARR if they convert within 90 days, and (4) security questionnaire acknowledged. Otherwise platform fee applies on production.

miguel_se: +1. I'll produce a short runbook for the VPC install and a simplified security note (network flows, KMS/keys, and logs). For the pilot we can use temporary managed keys; production requires customer KMS/HSM.

alyssa_sales: They also asked about SSO during pilot (Okta) and KMS. Can we allow SSO later and use a placeholder for pilot?

miguel_se: Yes — we can do a lightweight SSO stub for the pilot (Okta redirect to a test tenant). KMS: temporary managed keys are okay for pilot, but note in the MOU that production requires customer-owned KMS.

ben_dealdesk: I'll pre-approve the conditional waiver as long as legal signs the MOU template and RevOps publishes a quote with conditional lines. @sarah_revenueops can you prepare a quote with expiry and conditional platform credit?

sarah_revenueops: On it. I'll create a quote with two line items: PLATFORM_PRIVATE ($20k/yr) with a conditional -100% credit line for 8 weeks expiring 30 days after pilot end, and SUPPORT_STD by default. Quote will include acceptance criteria and a 90-day conversion clause. Quote ID TBD.

alyssa_sales: Perfect. I'll send MOU + security questionnaire to the customer today and request signatures. Will include the acceptance criteria: throughput, latency, and eval prompt set.

miguel_se: I'll drop the runbook and a short architecture diagram in the thread after this message. Also will attach a sample SIEM log snippet for their security folks.

ben_dealdesk: Please add me to the SFDC opp and capture the expected ARR and conversion criteria. We need a clean path for finance to convert the pilot credit into invoice adjustments if they don't convert.

deploy-bot: quote 1775123456 created in quotes-db (internal id q-2026-9943)

alyssa_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up once MOU signed. 

miguel_se: No objections from me. :thumbsup:

ben_dealdesk: leaning green. will finalize once quote ID is in SFDC.
